title: Charges against NEA in Relation to the Incident at Tuas Incineration Plant
what_it_is: Charges against NEA in Relation to the Incident at Tuas Incineration Plant

sections.label: Sub judice caution and NEA officers
sections.summary: The Speaker advises Members to exercise caution as the Statement relates to a case before the Courts, and notes two NEA officers lost their lives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: But before I call on Minister Grace Fu to deliver her Statement, I wish to highlight to Members that the subject matter of the Statement is related to a case before the Courts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Therefore, pursuant to Standing Order 50(2), reference should not be made to any matter which is sub judice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I would, therefore, like to advise Members to exercise caution in discussing or reflecting the details of the case before the Court as it could be sub judice or prejudice the investigations and the interests of the parties to the matters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Two NEA officers, Senior Engineering Manager and Head of the Electrical Maintenance Branch Mr Kwok Yeow Wai and Executive Engineering Manager Mr Wee Eng Leng, lost their lives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Between them, they contributed nearly 85 years of service to NEA.

sections.label: Induced Draft Fan control failure
sections.summary: On 23 September 2021, an Induced Draft Fan could not be switched off from the central control room.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: On the afternoon of 23 September 2021, an Induced Draft Fan could not be switched off from the central control room, where the equipment is normally controlled.

sections.label: Explosion at electrical switch room
sections.summary: A localised explosion happened near the switch gear at the electrical switch room.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: At the electrical switch room, a localised explosion happened near the switch gear.

sections.label: Charges against NEA and officers
sections.summary: Charges were filed against NEA as a body corporate and two senior NEA officers under the Workplace Safety and Health Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Charges have been filed against NEA as a body corporate and two senior NEA officers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: NEA has been charged under section 12(1) of the Workplace Safety and Health Act, read with section 20 and punishable under section 50(b), for failing to take, so far as was reasonably practicable, such measures as were necessary to ensure the safety and health of its employees at work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Mr Ng Wah Yong, the General Manager of the plant at the time, as well as Mr Lee Yew Binn Christopher, Director of the Waste Infrastructure Operations and Management Division at the time, were charged under section 15(3A) of the Workplace Safety and Health Act, for negligently endangering the safety of others at the plant without reasonable cause.

sections.label: Recommendations implemented at Tuas South
sections.summary: All recommendations were accepted by NEA's senior management and implemented at Tuas South Incineration Plant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, all the recommendations were accepted by NEA's senior management and have been implemented at Tuas South Incineration Plant, the only waste incineration plant which NEA currently operates.

sections.label: Review after Court decision
sections.summary: After the Court's decision is released, the Ministry will work with NEA's board to study it and assess personnel matters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: After the Court's decision is released, my Ministry will work with the board of NEA to study the Court's decision and assess how it should be reflected on personnel matters, including performance assessment, remuneration and disciplinary action, if and where appropriate.

sections.label: Charges over Tuas explosion
sections.summary: Charges were filed against NEA and two senior officers under the Workplace Safety and Health Act over a Tuas Incineration Plant explosion on 23 September 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   Charges were filed against the NEA and two senior NEA officers under the Workplace Safety and Health Act in relation to an explosion at Tuas Incineration Plant on 23 September 2021.

sections.label: NEA operational review, external validation
sections.summary: NEA is undertaking a broader operational review of its waste management facilities and seeking external validation of its workplace safety and health practices later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: NEA is undertaking a broader operational review of its waste management facilities and seeking external validation of its workplace safety and health practices later this year.

sections.label: Tribute to deceased workers
sections.summary: Everyone has a part in workplace safety and health; tribute is paid to Mr Kwok Yeow Wai and Mr Wee Eng Leng, who died in the incident.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: All of us have a part to play to ensure workplace safety and health, so that every worker can return home safely to their loved ones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We pay our tribute to Mr Kwok Yeow Wai and Mr Wee Eng Leng who passed away in the incident and offer our condolences to their families for their loss.

sections.label: Industry updates and family support
sections.summary: Working relations of informing the industry about improved practices continue, and families have been assisted with medical expenses, workmen's compensation, and psychological and well-being support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I think we will continue with these working relations of informing the industry about practices and processes that we have made improvements on.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I would also like to repeat that we have been assisting the families from medical expenses to workmen's compensation and also psychological and well-being support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Psychological support and also just being there for the families has continued until today.

sections.label: Strengthening WSH practices
sections.summary: Dedicated staff undertake WSH responsibilities, steps continue to strengthen WSH practices including risk assessment, and NEA will work with industry, private operators and MOM on compliance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I think I have covered the points raised in my speech, but I will reiterate that we do have dedicated staff undertaking the WSH responsibilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Also, we have taken steps to continue to strengthen the WSH practices, including in the area of risk assessment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: And we will work very closely with the industry, the private operators, together with MOM to ensure compliance with the existing laws and regulations.
